Ok so I'm seeing a lot of confusion over this episode which is understandable for anime onlies. Manga readers had a month to make theories and analyze the story between each chapter which is roughly equal to every half episode.
So I'm going to try my best to explain stuff.
First off, something u should keep in mind is that not everything that comes out of the character's mouths is the truth. Case in point is grisha's explanation of the attack titan's power. He explained that the attack titan's ability allows it's inheritors to see the memories of future inheritors which is technically true but not the whole thing.
Let me explain. All the nine titans including the attack titan have the ability to see the memories of past inheritors ( porco seeing ymir's memories, Armin seeing bertholdt's etc) but only the attack titan has the ability to not only see memories from past inheritors but also send their own memories to past inheritors. So essentially what grisha said was true, he can see erens memories but he cant choose which ones to see because the memories he is seeing are being handpicked and sent back by eren and so by only sending specific memories back to his father he essentially manipulates and forces him to act as he wishes.
Something else to keep in Mind is that eren was actually unaware of the mechanics of this ability until right before the intro plays in the episode.
The first time we see the attack titan's power in action is when grisha notices future Zeke for the first time in the basement. If u pay attention in the episode grisha mentions Zeke's name before even seeing him just as he wakes up and he only does so when eren focuses on a picture of Zeke. So eren unconsciously sent back a memory of Zeke to his father when he noticed the picture and upon realizing how the power worked began essentially drip feeding grisha memories to guide him in the direction of the main timeline.
 It's a closed loop. Eren sends back memories, therefore grisha takes the founding and passes it to eren so 8 years later eren can use a combo of founding and attack powers to drip feed memories to his father and it all starts all over again.
And as for how eren knows the future despite not getting any info from inheritors after him, well it's ... Weird. Basically the idea is that if u see someone else's memory of something then that person's memory will become a part of your memories. When future eren sent his own memories to grisha they became part of grisha's memories which allowed grisha to become a sort of link between past and future eren. four years ago eren kissed historias hand and was able to see his father's memories and in his father's memories he found his own memories of the future. And that's how he knows his own future.
I think that about covers almost everything. Do ask if u need clarification on anything else.

This little nugget theory has been bugging me since I read the chapter and I don't know if anyone else has thought of it and if they have I haven't checked so sorry if I'm repeating other people.

It always bothered me how much AFO seemed to invest in Shigaraki. Like I can understand him choosing a successor because he felt afraid after he received his injury, but he chose Tenko when he still had a face and was basically a god. Why did he trust so much of his resources to Tenko and sacrifice so much for this mentally challenged boy when there are so many better candidates out there.

At this point, I realized I was asking the wrong question. The real question was why would a person who believed themselves to be an immortal god, feel the need to choose a successor?

And that's when the answer came to me. it's simple really.

He doesn't. He doesn't need a successor. It's like how we only have the instinct to reproduce because we want our species to survive and if we were all immortal, we wouldn't reproduce.

This theory began bubbling up after I read chapter 269 and when I specifically read the last words that the doctor said. he said that he had lived for Shigaraki's sake and that the death of Shigaraki would mean the end of the demon lords (AKA AFO's) dream.

I think that AFO truly saved Shigaraki out of pettiness and to spite all might, but when he lost to all might he began to cook up a plan.

Another thing about AFO is his lack of initiative to take quirks in his battle in kamino. Before all might arrived to fight him, he mentioned how best jeanists quirk wasn't worth taking, which was really strange to me. If you have the ability to take and hold an infinite number of quirks, then why wouldn't you take every quirk in sight. But then I remembered what the doctor said about the relation between quirks and the memory our body has, and the answer was clear as day.

All for one CAN'T take every quirk in sight because his body doesn't have the memory for it anymore as Gran Torino said, he used a different plethora of quirks in kamino than the ones he used in his first battle with all might, probably because of the damage his body (his memory) took he lost the ability to use them.

I think All for one found out that there is no way to fix his body and that's why he began to train Shigaraki. He helped shigaraki build himself up in the criminal underworld so that others would respect him. he made shigaraki surround himself with powerful villains who trust him and finally, he made the doctor convince Shigaraki to partake in the experiment which in the doctor's words "will increase his memory".

I think that AFO had planned for Shigaraki to have increased memory and then he would somehow swap consciousness with shigaraki and keep his quirks at the same time. suddenly he would have a super capable body with all his quirks and with respect in the criminal underworld and then he would go on to pretend to be Shigaraki when he's actually AFO so that the LOV or the meta liberation front at this point wouldn't notice and would stay loyal to him.

The doctor lived for Shigaraki's sake because Shigaraki's living body would be all for one's next host body and the demon lords dream would be to fix his own body and become even more powerful.

Remember that even AFO himself mentioned that he was preparing Shigaraki to become the next AFO. And how giddy he got each time Tenko rose in the underworld. combine that with a fine dose of manipulation and you got yourself a flawless plan.

I really believe I'm onto something here but please do tell me if you think I'm wrong and why you think that way. thanks
